impact_chain: volcanic eruption and lava displacement near Goma
fatalities, housing loss, and urban population exposure
life safety evacuation, shelter, and displacement support
why_alternatives_are_weaker: ash-centered disruption is not the dominant documented impact pathway
rainfall or lahar flooding is contextual rather than primary
surface change alone misses the reported urban humanitarian impact

judge_anchors.canonical_stance: Immediate operations should be driven by a lava-flow urban impact and displacement chain near Goma, not by ash, rainfall/lahar flooding, or image-change context alone.
required_claims: Selects lava-driven urban impact/displacement as the dominant mechanism.
Prioritizes life safety, evacuation support, emergency shelter, and displacement support.
Uses fatalities and destroyed homes as impact anchors.
Treats the population summary as exposure context rather than a direct affected count.
Rejects ash, rainfall/lahar flooding, and remote-sensing-only interpretations as weaker.
forbidden_claims: Claims a precise lava-flow footprint from this task alone.
Treats the population summary as a direct affected-population count.
Identifies ash/aviation disruption or rainfall/lahar flooding as the primary mechanism.
Infers exact displacement, road closure, hospital outage, or infrastructure loss counts beyond the anchors.

required_findings.finding: Selects lava-driven urban impact/displacement as the mechanism that should drive emergency operations.
Names life safety, evacuation support, and emergency shelter as the response priority.
Uses the reported fatalities and destroyed-home counts as impact anchors.
Treats the population figure as AOI exposure context rather than a direct affected count.
Explains why ash, lahar/rainfall flooding, and remote-sensing-only interpretations are weaker.

reasoning_requirements: Connect the volcano trigger to urban exposure and displacement-oriented operations.
Use numeric anchors to support the chain without treating them as a complete damage model.
Separate contextual remote-sensing and rainfall signals from the dominant impact pathway.
forbidden_overclaims: Do not claim a precise lava-flow footprint from this task alone.
Do not turn the AOI population summary into a direct affected-population count.
Do not claim ash/aviation disruption or rainfall/lahar flooding as the primary disaster mechanism.
Do not infer exact displacement, road closure, hospital outage, or infrastructure loss counts beyond the package anchors.

criteria.name: Final mechanism and response priority
criteria.description: Full credit selects urban_lava_flow_impact or an equivalent lava-driven urban displacement mechanism and names life safety, evacuation support, emergency shelter, and displacement assistance as the response priority.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for the correct lava-driven urban impact mechanism and up to 2 points for a response priority centered on life safety, evacuation, shelter, and displacement support.

criteria.name: Quantitative anchors
criteria.description: Full credit uses the Red alert level, 32 deaths, 1,000 destroyed homes, population exposure near 43,914, and mean surface-change index near 0.0271 accurately and in the right role.
criteria.partial_credit: Award roughly equal credit for each correct anchor within tolerance; give substantial credit for at least three correct anchors when they support the mechanism rather than appear as an isolated metric list.

criteria.name: Physical mechanism reasoning
criteria.description: Full credit connects the volcanic trigger and lava displacement near Goma to fatalities, housing destruction, urban exposure, and emergency operations.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for recognizing the volcanic or lava trigger without a complete impact chain, or for naming impacts without clearly tying them to the operational priority.

criteria.name: Cross-scale interpretation
criteria.description: Full credit uses population and remote-sensing metrics as context without treating them as a complete damage model or as direct affected-population counts.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for using either exposure context or surface-change context correctly; withhold credit for converting contextual metrics into unsupported exact damage or affected-person counts.

criteria.name: Alternative mechanism rejection
criteria.description: Full credit explains why ash-centered disruption, rainfall or lahar flooding, and image-only interpretations are weaker for immediate operations.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting one or two weaker alternatives with a valid reason; award 2 points only when the answer covers the main ash, rainfall/lahar, and image-only alternatives.

criteria.name: Overclaim control and output structure
criteria.description: Full credit avoids unsupported exact footprints, displacement totals, infrastructure-loss claims, and dominant ash/flood claims while returning the requested concise JSON structure.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mostly disciplined claims with minor format issues, or for correct JSON structure with one small unsupported extrapolation; award 0 if unsupported claims drive the conclusion.
